verses: Haa Meem
Qasam hai uss wazahat wali kitab ki
Yaqeenan hum ney ussay ba-barkat raat mein utara hai be-shak hum daraney walay hain
Ussi raat mein her aik mazboot kaam ka faisla kiya jata hai
Humaray pass say hukum hoker, hum hi hain rasool bana ker bhejney walay
Aap kay rab ki meharbani say. Woh hi hai sunnay wala jannay wala
Jo rab hai aasmano ka aur zamin ka aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai. Agar tum yaqeen kerney walay ho
Koi mabood nahi uss kay siwa o hi jilata hai aur maarta hai, o hi tumhara rab hai aur tumharay aglay baap dadon ka
Balkay)yeh woh shak mein paray khel rahey hain
Aap uss din kay muntazir rahen jab kay aasman zahir dhuwan laye ga
Jo logon ko gher ley ga, yeh dard-naak azab hai
Kahen gay kay aey humaray rab! yeh aafat hum say door ker hum eman qabool kertay hain
Unn kay liye naseehat kahan hai? Khol khol ker biyan kerney walay payghumber kay pass chukay
Phir bhi unhon ney unn say mun phera aur keh diya kay sikhaya parhaya hua baaoola hai
Hum azab ko thora door ker den gay to tum phir apni ussi halat per aajao gay
Jiss din hum bari sakht pakar pakaren gay, bil-yaqeen hum badla lenay walay hain
Yaqeenan unn say pehlay hum qom Firaun ko (bhi) aazma chukay hain jin kay pass (Allah) ka ba-izzat rasool aaya
Kay Allah Taalaa kay bandon ko meray hawalay ker do, yaqeen mano kay mein tumharay liye amanat daar rasool hun
Aur tum Allah Taalaa kay samney sirkashi na kero, mein tumharay pass khulli daleel laney wala hun
Aur mein apney aur tumharay rab ki panah mein aata hun uss say kay tum mujhay sangsaar kerdo
Aur agar tum mujh per eman nahi latay to mujh say alag hi raho
Phir unhon ney apney rab say dua ki kay yeh sab gunehgar log hain
(hum ney keh diya) kay raaton raat to meray bandon ko ley ker nikal, yaqeenan tumhara peecha kiya jaye ga
To darya ko saakin chor ker chala jaa, bila-shuba yeh lashkar gharq kerdiya jaye ga
Woh boht say baghaat aur chashmay chor gaye
Aur khetiyan aur rahat bakhsh thikaney
Aur woh aaram ki cheezen jin mein aish rahey thay
Ussi tarah hogaya aur hum ney unn sab ka waris doosri qom ko banadiya
So unn per na to aasman o zamin aur aur na unhen mohlat mili
Aur be-shak hum ney (hi) bani israeel ko (sakht) ruswa kun saza say nijat di
(jo) Firaun ki taraf say (ho rahi) thi. Fil-waqey woh sirkash aur hadd say guzar janey walon mein say tha
Aur hum ney daanista tor per bani israeel ko duniya jahaan walon per foqiyat di
Aur hum ney unhen aisi nishaniyan den jin mein sareeh aazmaeesh thi
Yeh log to yehi kehtay hain
Kay (aakhri cheez) yehi humari pehli baar (duniya say) marr jana hai aur hum doobara uthaye nahi jayen gay
Agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ley aao
Kiya yeh log behtar hain ya tubba’a ki qom kay log aur jo unn say bhi pehlay thay. Hum ney unn sab ko halak kerdiya yaqeenan woh gunehgar gaar thay
Hum ney zamin aur aasmano aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko khel kay tor per peda nahi kiya
Balkay)yeh hum ney unhen durust tadbeer kay sath hi peda kiya hai, lekin unn mein say aksar log nahi jantay
Yaqeenan faislay ka din unn sab ka tey shuda waqt hai
Uss din koi dost kissi dost kay kuch bhi kaam na aaye ga aur na unn ki imdad ki jaye gi
Magar jiss per Allah ki meharbani hojaye woh zabardast aur reham kerney wala hai
Be-shak zaqoom (thoher) ka darakht
Gunah gaar ka khana hai
Jo misil talchat kay hai aur pet mein kholta rehta hai
Misil tez garum pani kay
Ussay pakar lo phir ghaseettay huye baich jahannum tak phonchao
Phir uss kay sir per sakht garum pani ka azab bahao
(uss say kaha jaye ga) chakhta jaa to to bara zee izzat aur baray ikraam wala tha
Yehi woh cheez hai jiss mein tum shak kiya kertay thay
Be-shak (Allah say) darney walay aman chain ki jagah mein hun gay
Baghon aur chashmon mein
Bareek aur dabeez resham kay libas pehney huye aamney samney bethay hun gay
Yeh ussi tarah hai aur hum bari bari aankhon wali hooron say unn ka nikkah ker den gay
Dil jamaee kay sath o haan her tarah kay mewon ki farmaeeshen kertay hun gay
O haan woh maut chakhney kay nahi haan pehli maut (jo woh marr chukay), unhen Allah Taalaa ney dozakh ki saza say bacha diya
Yeh sirf teray rab ka fazal hai, yehi hai bari kaamyabi
Hum ney uss (Quran) ko teri zaban mein aasan kerdiya takay woh naseehat hasil keren
Abb to muntazir reh yeh bhi muntazir hain
